Test samples

Made-up prescription and medicine packs for testing On Time. Not a real patient, clinic or medicine maker.

How to test on your phone

  1. Press and hold each picture below, then tap Save to Photos (or Download image).
  2. Open On Time → Set up my family (patient Lakshmi), then Medicines.
  3. Upload the prescription. AI fills in 7 medicines; check them and save.
  4. Under Medicine packs at home, upload all 7 pack photos. AI matches each one and counts the tablets left.
  5. Call now, and on the call ask “ఈ tablet ఏది?” to see the pack photo.
